attempt_budget: At most 3 pivot candidates (one per family P1/P2/P3) + CASH reference. No extras, no reruns for selection. Mechanical reruns preserve identical configuration and are disclosed. S1-S5/X1 taker-scalp configs are NOT re-entered (prior rounds rejected/unresolved; re-entry would be data-snooping).

costs.adverse: 2x realistic (taker_bps x2 AND spread x2, frozen definition per X1 round). Selection requires val net > 0 under BOTH.
costs.contract: cost-contract-v1 (src/cryptobot/costs.py): roundtrip = 2*(fee+slippage) + spread_full + funding. Estimates recorded separately, never booked.
costs.hurdle_note: Every pivot family must declare target_bps >> hurdle_bps BEFORE scoring. Families whose min target does not exceed the realistic hurdle are rejected at preregistration, not after outcomes.
costs.realistic: Nautilus paper engine, taker 5bps/leg + observed/modelled spread + slippage + funding, submit+fill latency >=50/50ms.

data.coverage_note: Capped windows (30min/2h) are descriptive only. Qualification requires full-window replay; DATA BLOCKED verdict otherwise.

designations.calibration: Sealed before round; any fitted parameter (e.g. beta) uses calibration ONLY, frozen before dev/val contact, disclosed.
designations.test: TEST split BURNED for this round unless a candidate qualifies on dev+val; scored once.

data.floor_for_enrollment: A dataset enrolls for QUALIFICATION only if it carries, per symbol: L2 book or bookTicker quotes (no modelled spread), aggTrades, marks >=1s, funding settlements with provenance, monotonic seq. Quote-less or funding-absent datasets are development-only (descriptive, never qualifying).
data.requirement: >=10 days untouched tick (book/depth + trades + marks + funding + seq), unseen by any prior round. Current repo captures (cap-30min/cap-2h, bench30d) do NOT satisfy this: pivot status is DATA BLOCKED until fresh self-capture ($0, owner-run) or Tardis Solo re-audit lands.

families.hypothesis: Post-only maker fills earn spread/rebate instead of paying taker costs; edge = queue-position + short-horizon toxicity filter (cancel on adverse flow), not directional prediction.
families.invalidation: Maker fill rate too low to reach 100 OOS fills in window, or adverse-selection cost exceeds captured spread under realistic queue model.
families.kill: Adverse markout at fill+5s worse than -spread/2 on average, or realized spread capture < 0 after fees.

families.hypothesis: 8h funding + perp/spot basis carry persists intraday; edge = holding through funding settlements delta-neutral or directionally hedged, turnover ~1/day so 26bps is amortized.
families.invalidation: Realized funding net of borrow/hedge costs <= 0 over >=10d, or basis converges faster than hedge rebalance.
families.kill: Net funding carry <= 0 after all hedge legs and fees on VAL.

families.hypothesis: 4h+ swing continuation on 1h+ features; edge = lower turnover (costs <10% of ATR) with wider stops; prediction horizon matches retail latency budget.
families.invalidation: Time-exit rate > 70% with net <= 0, or gross per trade < 2x hurdle.
families.kill: VAL net <= 0 realistic OR adverse, or <100 OOS fills across 10d.

kill_criteria_global: VAL closed_positions < 100 OR covered_days < 10 → DATA BLOCKED / UNRESOLVED, never QUALIFIED.
VAL net <= 0 under realistic OR adverse → REJECTED.
Any fitted parameter touched dev/val/test before freezing → round VOID, re-preregister.
Coverage from capped windows only → descriptive, never qualifying.
prior_use_disclosure: S1/S2/S3/S4/S5/X1 taker-scalp evidence (CORR Phase B 0 fills, REL-R1 NONE, X1-R1 NONE/UNRESOLVED, H-R2 0/60 counterfactual wins) stands. Pivot families are NEW mechanisms with different cost physics; they must still clear the same economic screen on FRESH data.
selection_rule: At most ONE pivot config advances: highest VAL realistic ledger net among configs with DEV net > 0 AND VAL net > 0 (realistic) AND VAL net > 0 (adverse) AND >=100 VAL closed positions spanning >=10d; ties break by higher DEV net, then lexical config_id; else NONE. CASH never advances (reference only).
